mission: Make every canonical DreamCo bot a measurable product and business unit with an operating, sales, marketing, support and improvement blueprint grounded in repository evidence.
evidence_rule: A feature, revenue number, customer result, integration or capability is not marked verified merely because code or documentation claims it exists. Verification requires executable tests, live-safe evidence, or a clearly labeled simulation.
revenue_rule: Pricing and revenue projections are planning estimates unless backed by transaction records or an approved sandbox simulation.
